2608.20804.title: Denoising the Future: Context-Aware Spectral Diffusion for Temporal Knowledge Graph Extrapolation
2608.20804.paper_summary: Temporal Knowledge Graph (TKG) extrapolation seeks to infer future facts from time-varying relational histories. Recent diffusion-based approaches improve uncertainty modeling through generative denoising, but their aggregated conditioning on subject histories may insufficiently distinguish query-specific evidence from non-salient historical facts, thereby diluting target-discriminative signals. To bridge this gap, we propose FreqDiff, a Frequency-aware Diffusion framework for TKG extrapolation. Specifically, FreqDiff formulates future object prediction as query-slot denoising and develops a dual-stream denoiser that integrates temporal dependency modeling with context-aware spectral calibration. The spectral branch synthesizes history-conditioned filters from learnable bases to adaptively re-calibrate denoising representations, while a frequency-domain regularizer is proposed to align the denoised target with the gold object in spectral space. Experiments on four public TKG benchmarks demonstrate that FreqDiff achieves state-of-the-art performance.
2608.20804.paper_summary_zh: 時間知識圖譜（TKG）外推旨在從隨時間變化的關係歷史中推斷未來事實。最近的基於擴散的方法通過生成去噪來改善不確定性建模，但它們對主體歷史的聚合條件可能不足以區分查詢特定的證據與不顯著的歷史事實，從而稀釋了目標區分信號。為了彌補這一差距，我們提出了FreqDiff，一種針對TKG外推的頻率感知擴散框架。具體而言，FreqDiff將未來對象預測公式化為查詢槽去噪，並開發了一個雙流去噪器，將時間依賴建模與上下文感知的頻譜校準相結合。頻譜分支從可學習基礎合成歷史條件過濾器，以自適應地重新校準去噪表示，而提出了一個頻率域正則化器，以將去噪的目標與頻譜空間中的金標對齊。在四個公共TKG基準上的實驗表明，FreqDiff達到了最先進的性能。
